stories.title: Brewers Championship Parade Draws 750,000+ to Milwaukee Streets

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
750,000+ people packed Milwaukee streets for the Brewers World Series parade yesterday.

Nearly double the 400K originally expected.

The city waited 57 years for this. Worth every second. #Brewers #WorldSeries

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Milwaukee held a sold-out rally at American Family Insurance Amphitheater after the parade.

Schools closed. Streets packed. A city that's never had this before finally got it.

What a moment for Wisconsin. #Brewers #WorldSeries
